ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Acutaas Chemicals Limited has announced the re-appointment of Mr. Ram Mohan Lokhande as Whole Time Director and Mrs. Anita Bandyopadhyay as an Independent Director, both for five-year terms commencing February 8, 2027. This signifies a commitment to leadership continuity and stable corporate governance, retaining experienced professionals in key operational and oversight roles. The disclosure confirms standard compliance with SEBI regulations, noting no related-party issues or debarments, indicating a routine and compliant corporate action without any apparent red flags.
